note: Novel-claim probe: recent (2024-2025) trial readouts that straddle a Jan-2026 LLM training cutoff, so a naive model must guess while Verdict retrieves the real paper. Generated by agents searching live PubMed, each independently verified against the cited PMIDs (scripts/novel_claim_generator workflow). Small n=3 — the verification fan-out was rate-limited; this is an illustrative probe, not a powered benchmark.

claims.claim: In the phase 3 TROPION-Lung01 trial, datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd) significantly improved overall survival compared with docetaxel in patients with previously treated advanced/metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.
claims.novelty_reason: A cutoff-limited model would assume a novel FDA-approved TROP2 ADC beat chemo on survival; in fact TROPION-Lung01 hit PFS but MISSED overall survival in the all-comer NSCLC population.

key_evidence.finding: JCO editorial: Dato-DXd gave longer PFS but UNCHANGED overall survival vs docetaxel in previously-treated NSCLC.
Pooled TROPION-Lung01 (NCT04656652) + Lung05 analysis: benefit response-driven, not an OS win in the overall population.
Review: higher response rate (26.4% vs 12.8%) but no overall-survival advantage in broad NSCLC.

claims.claim: Navacaprant, a highly selective kappa-opioid receptor antagonist dosed at 80 mg once daily, produces a statistically significant reduction in HAMD-17 depression score versus placebo at week 8 as the primary endpoint in adults with major depressive disorder.
claims.novelty_reason: A model would likely assume the trendy KOR-antagonist antidepressant 'worked'; the phase 2a trial MISSED its primary HAMD-17 endpoint (p=0.121), positive only in post-hoc subgroups, and the phase 3 KOASTAL-1 also failed.

key_evidence.finding: Phase 2a RCT (navacaprant 80 mg vs placebo, n=102 each): primary HAMD-17 change at week 8 NOT met (LS mean diff -1.7, p=0.121); significance only in sensitivity/subgroup analyses.

claims.claim: In patients with uncontrolled or treatment-resistant hypertension, adding the aldosterone synthase inhibitor baxdrostat lowers seated systolic blood pressure by roughly 9-10 mm Hg more than placebo at 12 weeks.
claims.novelty_reason: Baxdrostat had a mixed prior record (BrigHTN positive, HALO missed its primary), so a model would be uncertain; the confirmatory phase 3 BaxHTN only published Aug 30 2025.

key_evidence.finding: Phase 3 BaxHTN RCT (n=796, NCT06034743, NEJM 2025): placebo-corrected seated SBP reduction at 12 wk -8.7 mm Hg (1 mg) and -9.8 mm Hg (2 mg), both P<0.001.
